comment: Hand-maintained escape hatch for sweep entries the generator's
conventions cannot resolve (see ltp_harness/sweep.py). source names
the file that classifies the result format and, by default, the
build directory; source_dir overrides the build directory when the
binary is compiled from another directory's source. timeout_seconds
raises above the sweep default promote an entry to sweep-slow.
